alternatives_rejected.why: A delay on frontend's own network would slow all its callees about equally. Instead, calls to productcatalogservice slowed 30x (E2) while calls to adservice slowed only 2.18x (E3). recommendationservice, which does not go through frontend's network, also shows a huge latency-90 spike (E1, E5). Frontend's self-time rise (E6) is consistent with waiting on productcatalogservice.

Its own self-time rose only 2.91x (E5), compared with productcatalogservice's 30x inbound rise (E2). Its p90 spike (E1) is consistent with it waiting on slow productcatalogservice calls, which it normally makes in online-boutique (not confirmed with service_map here).
The huge error z-score comes from a near-zero baseline, with errors only going 0.0->0.0045. Its latency rose only 2.18x and only on calls from frontendservice (E3).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice's pod or network interface for injected latency (for example, a tc/netem qdisc) and remove it. Then confirm that inbound p50 returns to about 2.4ms and that frontend and recommendation latency recover. If the delay cannot be found, do a rolling restart of the productcatalogservice pod.
